Package dev.ucomprotocol.ap2

package dev.ucomprotocol.ap2
  • Class
    Description
    Ap2CommerceAdapter
    Decorator for CommerceAdapter that automatically applies the UCP 2026-08-25 AP2 Mandates extension (dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate) to checkout sessions.
    Ap2ErrorCode
    Canonical error codes defined by the UCP dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate specification (2026-08-25).
    Ap2MandateException
    Exception raised when AP2 mandate enforcement or cryptographic verification fails during checkout processing.
    Ap2MandateService
    Cryptographic service implementing the UCP 2026-08-25 AP2 Mandates extension (dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate).
    JcsCanonicalizer
    RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) serializer used to produce deterministic UTF-8 byte representations of UCP checkout payloads prior to AP2 JWS signing and verification.
    JwkKey
    Public JSON Web Key (JWK, RFC 7517) published in /.well-known/ucp keys[] or configured as a trusted platform signing key for AP2 mandate verification.
